title: Tweed Beard and the Glenn Miller era
summary: Working with bassist Tweed Beard around the time Glenn Miller was hot.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Let's see. I started working with a bass player out of Columbus, Ohio, named Tweed(?) Beard around this time. And he was... He wasn't the greatest bass player, but he could make a great presentation, you know, and he was a pretty boy and everything. And he always had good guys around him. That's just about the time when Glenn Miller was really getting hot, you know, with "String of Pearls" and all those things. But I had listened to him on the jukeboxes back home earlier, one of his first hits, "In The Mood." And I
listened to Fats Waller and all of them...
